runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, limited late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat rear, switched out at the Turn, showed some dash over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。末段略為加速上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, forced to steady 1000m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on well to lead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處被迫收慢。五百米處受催策。走勢良佳，接近終點時在多駒幾乎齊過終點下率先衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, keen middle stages, driven along 500m out, ran on well final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。中段搶口。五百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, not best of runs final 200m but ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路早段空位不足。最後二百米未能完全望空，但走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Sat towards rear, held up at the Turn, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列。直路彎受困。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, not enough room near 200M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，與他駒互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時空位不足。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the inside early, angled out after entering the back straight, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段居後列，走內疊。進入對面直路後向外移出。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide after entering the back straight, moved closer after passing 900M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後走第三疊。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced 3 wide behind midfield, hard ridden after passing 550M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過五百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Raced midfield 2 wide, swung wide for home before running on at same pace early straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時移出外疊。直路初上前，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, no clear run final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in last few 3-wide with cover, widest runner turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure down the centre of the straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。直路上受催策，在跑道中央以穩勢上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Mid-division, three wide, pushed along halfway and struggling to hold position, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時受推策，難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Prominent early, caught behind weakening runner from halfway and shuffled back to rear by top of home straight, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段居前列。自半程起在轉弱的對手之後受困，直路初前墮居後列。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced wide throughout from high draw, one paced under pressure from 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後沿途走外疊。自四百米處起在催策下保持同速。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Out with rest, positioned slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Tracked leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide after passing 450M, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, hit the front 75M, kept on well to the line and scored. (Dead-Heat)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後走第三疊。直路初未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空。七十五米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。（平頭冠軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W3W) Held up last, pushed along and outpaced middle stages, switched widest for clear run 200m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受推策，但未能跟上步速。二百米處移出最外疊以望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on outer, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat handy, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居前列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, stayed on, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sluggish start, rear of mid-field, no real impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。受催策，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Settled in mid-field on the inside, peaked early in straight, checked 150M, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內疊。直路初未能再增速。一百五十米處勒避。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield, made some progress under whip, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, once paced under pressure, late gains but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。末段追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Sat midfield 3 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W2W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡。居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位，直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三又四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, tended to hang in final 200m, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米傾向內閃。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W3W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W3W) Tracked leaders, headway final bend to chase leaders, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎上前追趕領先馬匹。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after leaving stall, pushed along to press leader, struggled to hold position on bend, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞。受推策，追迫領放馬。直路彎難以保持位置。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W3W6W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at tail throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自第九檔出閘後留後，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W3W4W) Held up, under pressure long way out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W3W4W) 留後。距離終點尚遠時已受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, kept on evenly inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, raced wide and without cover throughout, very limited when asked.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W3W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。對催策反應頗為有限。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Held up from wide draw, last and pushed along turning into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留後。轉入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W5W) Caught 3 wide just off midfield, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) From draw 14 moved up to track leader, pressed along 500M to be challenging for the lead, peaked on its run 200M, couldn't go on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自第十四檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速，無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden along 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, gave ground gradually inside 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列。最後三百米逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, similar position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved grounds in the turn, limited response when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。受催策時反應一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat just off pace, one pace to the line. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw switched off to race in last 8-9Ls back, proved difficult to ride out when hung in in the home straight, failed to quicken and only ran past a couple of beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後八至九個馬位。直路上內閃之際難以被力策。末段未能加速，僅能超越兩匹已洩氣的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer on turn, 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路初在催策下反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, similar position on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, never better than midfield, one paced under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat off midfield 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Rear of mid-field, limited response to pressure home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路上對催策反應平平。 毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。五百米處受推策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, dropped away quickly, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。迅速墮退，落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, switched out entering the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at tail, still last turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。直路上移出外疊。衝刺良佳。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, found rail 1050M, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。一千零五十米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 10th or 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列第九或第十位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 400M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。四百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, brief forward move early in home straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初一度發力上前。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, hard ridden from 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自四百五十米處起受力策。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W5W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on steadily to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處受催策。保持穩勢，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on very well in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position final bend, crowded and checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎在催策下保持位置。二百米處受擠迫及勒避，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W3W) Tracked pace, stuck to task under pressure but lacked pace to challenge winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策力拼，但速度不足以挑戰頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位，直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, hard ridden from 600M but only showed limited response, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。自六百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬一般。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, under pressure 550m to maintain position, headed early in home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。五百五十米處受催策以保持位置。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Settled in rear, ran on steadily behind runners in straight despite not having the clearest of runs throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列。沿途未能完全望空，但直路上仍在馬群後方以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W) Away well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, ridden along 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly and raced at the back, struggled to keep up with rivals middle stages, couldn't go on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段難以跟上對手。最後四百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Prominent early stages, given reminders to hold pace from 800M out, produced good late impression inside final 150M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。自八百米處起受鞭策以保持步速。最後一百五十米追前甚多。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, twice bumped 400m out to 350m out, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處至三百五十米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled keenly in the early stages, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，早段搶口。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) From wide draw shifted across behind runners, settled near last 5-6Ls back, failed to run on passing 400M. Never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，居接近包尾位置，落後五至六個馬位。跑過四百米處時未能追前，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear on the inside, eased after passing 600M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。跑過六百米處後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the lead, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持佳勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by D'Argento from Sarzana, a daughter of Animal Kingdom. Horses by the same sire include Leading Agility and Argento Ocean. He was given six trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished eighth under pressure, beaten by 7-1/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「白銀」(D'Argento)之後，在港同父馬包括「驕陽雄心」及「當家精彩」等駒，生母出自「動物王國」(Animal Kingdom)。抵港後試閘六次。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬7.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Soon taken back to the tail-end from the widest barrier, trailed the field into straight, baulked behind runners after straightening, finished off the race well inside final 200M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即留居包尾位置。入直路時尾隨馬群。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後二百米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Chased leaders, outpaced halfway out and gave ground, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追趕領先馬匹。半程時未能跟上步速及墮退。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, gave ground from the 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。自二百米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。走勢強勁，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Ridden along to share outside lead, traveled reasonably well, weakened passing 200M (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策，並排領先，走外疊。走勢不俗。跑過二百米處時轉弱。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Broke well from wide draw and across to make running, headed by winner 200m out, no extra final 100m and just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，切入以領放。二百米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米再無餘力，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent and wide early stages, just over 3L back rounding home bend, tired noticeably in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居前列，走外疊。轉直路彎時落後稍逾三個馬位。直路上已疲態畢呈。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field against far rail, ridden along halfway out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外欄。半程時受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear of mid-field on outer, pushed along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，離外欄競跑。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Towards rear after sluggish start, under pressure over 300m out, no impression.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。三百米處受催策。毫無表現。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; On jumping made contact with the left side of its starting gate, raced at tail, still 8 lengths back in the middle stages, made some headway final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;躍出時觸碰閘廂左側，居包尾位置，中段仍落後八個馬位。最後四百米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made good ground in the Straight, just unable to hold off the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上追前甚多，僅未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Checked on jumping, sat rear, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時勒避，居後列。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race at rear, travelled keenly after passing 800M, 3-1/2L back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列。跑過八百米處後搶口。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W5W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W5W) 自第十檔出閘，居最後數位之內。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Slowly into stride from wide draw, raced in last place, pushed along and a bit detached 500m out, good late headway final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。受推策，五百米處稍被拋離。最後一百五十米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, hampered near 850M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自第十檔出閘後留居中間位置，走外疊。接近八百五十米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, raced wide and without cover, weakened over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。末段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped ok and settled slightly worse than midfield, made minor progress final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Shifted out at start and bumped, raced at rear on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居後列，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Started well and tracked leader, led over 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, no extra and lost two places close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。接近終點時再無餘力，失去兩位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Travelled one back 3-wide without cover, came to join the leader rounding home bend, faded steadily inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。最後三百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Shared 5th about 3L off the pace on rail when checked and lost position 900M out, 4L back in 7th rounding home bend, no clear run early in straight and forced to check 300M out, produced some late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 並居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。九百米處勒避及失位。轉直路彎時居第七位，落後四個馬位。直路初未能望空。三百米處被迫勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly inside 150M (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。一百五十米處迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, weakened and gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Mid-field, switched inside 200m out, stayed on well final 100m and nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處向內移入。最後一百米保持佳勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。自三百米處起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out fast, stranded 3 wide no cover throughout, stuck on gamely despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘迅速，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay on the rail, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled towards the rear, made ground near the rail. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。靠近內欄追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Fast break, tracked leaders, driven along 550m out, outpaced and left behind final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。未能跟上步速，最後一百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Broke well before settling just over 2L back in 4th, gained 3rd but in a similar 2-wide position 1100M out, unable to quicken under pressure in home straight and weakened noticeably inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，其後居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。千一米處進佔第三位，走相若的第二疊。直路上在催策下未能加速。最後一百米顯著轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Prominent early drifting backward steadily despite ridden along, 3-wide without cover in midfield before shifting further back to 10th 950M out, wide home bend and into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 早段居前列，儘管受催策，但逐漸墮後。居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。其後進一步墮後，九百五十米處居第十位。直路彎及入直路時走外疊。持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made running, pressed by rivals 600m out, kicked 500m out, headed by winner 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 領放。六百米處受對手追迫。五百米處加速。三百米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Chased leaders in a fast run race, came with a strong looking challenge 350M and got within 0.5L of the eventual winner mid-straight, run soon ended however and found not much closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，賽事步速甚快。三百五十米處以勁勢上前挑戰，直路中段落後頭馬不逾半個馬位，但瞬即後勁不繼，末段無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shared pace early before obtaining cover in 3rd on rail rounding fist bend, gradually restrained to 2.5L 5th about 900M out, snuck up on rail turning into home straight, weakened inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段並排領先，轉首個彎位時居第三位，走內欄，有遮擋。逐漸受約束，約九百米處居第五位，落後兩個半馬位。入直路時沿欄上前。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W5W) Vied for the lead first turn before easing back to sit in 2nd, kept on well to chase winner early straight, no extra final stages and lost several places near line. (Jockey - distance is a little far for him.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W5W) 首次轉彎時爭奪領先，其後收慢留居第二位。直路早段保持佳勢，追趕頭馬。末段再無餘力，接近終點時失去數位。（騎師表示，此程對坐騎來說略嫌太長。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, mid division, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on strongly and won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。直路早段加速，二百米處領先。末段走勢強勁，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W3W3W) Given a patient ride, settled near last 6Ls off the pace before staying on mildly under top weight. Not able to threaten leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W3W3W) 居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位，留力候上。在負頂磅下保持穩勢。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W5W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run final 200m to close on winner but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，追近頭馬，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W1W1W1W) Settled near last about 6Ls off the pace, kept to inside on straightening, was making good progress when running to the back of the eventual winner near 100M. Could have finished closer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W1W1W1W) 居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬約六個馬位。入直路時固守內疊，追前甚多，但接近一百米處時在頭馬之後未能望空。應可跑得更接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, held up early part of the Straight, made some late ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路初受困。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W1W) Held up last and plenty to do, pushed along 500m out, stuck to inside rail and headway home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W1W) 留居包尾位置，落後頗遠。五百米處受推策。直路上固守內欄及追前。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, had some work to do 400M, stayed on moderately towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處仍落後頗遠。保持普通走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward from a poor draw, obtained one back 2-wide position 1100M out, in similar position but 3rd onto home bend, switched out to challenge 400M out, fought on dourly to get up final strides and just defy late challenges.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。千一米處居第二位，走第二疊。開始轉直路彎時居相若位置，但墮居第三位。四百米處向外移出以展開挑戰。末段力拼，最後數步取得領先，僅能力拒對手的挑戰，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Quickly into stride, up with early pace before sitting back to track leaders, run ended 250M then weakened rapidly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 展步迅速，早段跟上步速，其後留後，跟隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處無以為繼，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield but never far off from leaders, stayed on reasonably well final 300M. Not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米保持頗佳走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Driven forward form draw 10 to take up running, shook off rivals early straight to open up 2.5L lead mid-straight, caught by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自第十檔出閘後受催策上前領放。直路早段擺脫對手，直路中段帶離兩個半馬位。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, challenged the leaders early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sped forward to take up running, raced keenly entering back straight, opened up a big lead before steadying the pace home turn, ran on again final 200M to hold pursuing rivals at bay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 加速上前帶頭。進入對面直路時搶口。遙遙領先，其後在直路彎減慢步速。最後二百米再度上前，力拒緊追的對手掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced towards rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 800m out, ridden top of home straight, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。八百米處被迫收慢。直路初受催策。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Up with early pace then eased back to a position ahead of midfield and raced 3-wide without cover for majority of the race, soon no extra leaving the turn and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢留後，居中間之前位置。大部分途程走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑離直路彎時瞬即再無餘力，包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, unable to secure clear run 250m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處未能望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled towards the rear 3 wide, made no impression.
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。毫無表現。
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure and outpaced briefly over 300m out, stayed on to go second 100m out, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。受催策，三百米處一度未能跟上步速。保持走勢，一百米處進佔亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position and settled behind midfield 6Ls off leader, had some work to do 400M but failed to come into the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前的位置，居中間之後位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent to the lead under 7lb claimer, raced keenly and did not settle which resulted in the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time, headed nearing 200M then weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 由獲讓七磅的見習騎師策騎，受催策上前領放。搶口及未能穩定走勢，導致賽事早段及中段的步速較標準時間為快。接近二百米處時被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Caught wide early stages, retrained to a rear spot settled further back than intended, had some work to do 400M but made only limited progress to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，其後受約束以居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但末段僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 800m out, sustained headway to join leader 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。八百米處開始上前，走外疊。持續追前，二百米處追上領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, trapped behind horses for much of home straight, clear over 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上大部分途程在馬群之後受困。一百米處望空，但未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Sat midfield early, raced wide in the early stages and went forward to chase the leader, weakened from 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走外疊，其後上前追趕領放馬。自二百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) Mid division, switched wide with cover 800m out, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 居中間位置。八百米處移出外疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Stayed close to leaders but raced wide without cover for the majority of the race, hard driven from 450M, responded well to be challenging for the lead final stages, held by first two at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，但大部分途程走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百五十米處起受力策，反應良佳。末段爭奪領先，過終點時落後首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made contact near 400M, no clear early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, kept on well until final 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。接近四百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。保持佳勢直至五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W4W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, chased leaders 450m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處追趕領先馬匹。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相碰撞。居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 1150M, shared lead on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近一千一百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路早段保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw gradually settled just over 3L off the pace, came under pressure to challenge rounding home bend sharing 3rd briefly into straight, unable to make any further impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，逐漸落後領放馬稍逾三個馬位。轉直路彎時在催策下展開挑戰。入直路時一度並列第三位。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W4W) Obtained a handy position just ahead of midfield, close enough to the leaders home turn before driven out to take the lead near 200M, held on well from 2nd and 3rd late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W4W) 居中間稍前的好位。直路彎落後領先馬匹不遠。其後受力策，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒亞軍及季軍馬匹獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon took up running taking advantage of the one draw, set steady pace until joined 700M out, re-gained 1L break on straightening only to be denied 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 把握自第一檔出閘的優勢，瞬即取得領先。以平穩步速領放，七百米處被追上。入直路時重奪領先位置，帶離一個馬位。僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W4W) From wide draw slotted into a 3-wide spot in midfield, 4-5Ls to make up 400M, ran on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間位置，移入第三疊。四百米處落後四至五個馬位。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from gate 9, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, sent forward after entering the back straight, 2 wide from 1000M, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed near 250M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，但走外疊。入對面直路後受催策上前。自一千米處起走第二疊。入直路時並排領先。接近二百五十米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sped forward crossing to the lead, slowed down the pace one in front, headed near 300M and couldn't sustain run final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 加速上前，切入領放，隨即減慢步速。接近三百米處時被超越，末段無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W4W1W1W) From draw 12 caught wide no cover when going forward first turn, reached the lead 1100M and took them along at a slightly slow pace, headed mid-straight, faded late but managed to hold on for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W4W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘。首個彎位上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。千一米處取得領先，以偏慢步速領放。直路中段被超越。末段力竭，但保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, pressed by rivals to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。率先加速，直路初領先。受對手追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked pace out wide, dropped away quickly top of home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初迅速墮退。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, briefly impeded 500m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處一度受阻礙。自三百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on outer, struck heels and blundered near 1000M, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近一千米處時踢中對手後蹄及失蹄。入直路時落後四個半馬位，直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W3W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out 500M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settle at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Soon picked up to midfield after moderate start, kept on same pace without quickening in home straight, looked beaten when steadied 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通後瞬即加速，居中間位置。直路上保持同速，未能加速。一百五十米處在收慢之際看似洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded after sluggish start, raced in rear, headway through field from over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居後列。自二百米處起在馬群中穿插上前。保持走勢。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Slightly slow out and bumped, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，發生碰撞，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 lengths or so back, kept on same pace final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫。居中間之後位置，落後約三個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Away with them, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled well back from the widest barrier, ran on steadily down the centre of the track inside final 300M to reach 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。最後三百米在跑道中央以穩勢上前，末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, tight for room briefly 250m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百五十米處一度受緊迫。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W2W) Held up in last pair after hampered early, still well back entering home straight, looked green, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段受阻礙，其後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍遙居於後。看來走勢稚嫩，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent early, gradually taken backward reaching 11th on top of home bend, awkward on heels 700M out, dropped further behind into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居前列。逐漸留後，直路彎早段居第十一位。七百米處緊貼對手後蹄處於窘境。入直路時進一步墮後。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Crowded on jumping, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前，一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened inside 200M, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。最後二百米轉弱。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, baulked for a run in straight until the 250M and again 150M out, kept on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，遙居於後。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。一百五十米處再度受困。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, struggled to hold position from 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起難以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped start, raced towards rear on the stands' side, made no impression final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時發生碰撞，居後列，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover from 600M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, three wide in rear of mid-field, short-lived effort 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘後向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處一度發力。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, hit the front near 300M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。接近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped exiting stalls, ridden along from stalls to across, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，受催策以切入。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, commenced move out wide 600m out, under pressure 400m out, stuck to task, checked close home and lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處開始發力，走外疊。四百米處受催策，持續力拼。接近終點時勒避，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居前列，走第二疊。搶口。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W6W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。其後穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, short of room early in home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。直路初空位不足。末段走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, switched top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初轉換跑線。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last pair top of home straight, no impression.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居最後兩位，毫無表現。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide with cover, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Taken back from gate 13, raced 2 wide behind midfield, similar position on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 300M, closed off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能望空。趨近三百米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slowly away, dropped out from widest draw, widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘緩慢，墮後。入直路時走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Jumped awkwardly and ridden quietly from the tail of the field, overraced early stages, severely checked to avoid an accident around the 900M, showed limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置，未受催策。早段搶口。約九百米處時大力勒避一宗意外。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat box seat, kept on okay, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。保持不俗走勢。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至三百米處。末段以佳勢追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W6W) Held up very wide in last few without cover after beginning from a poor draw, travelling keenly and pulled closer very wide rounding home bend, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W6W) 自第十三檔出閘後留後，居最後數位之內，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。跑來搶口。轉直路彎時追近，走大外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly in the middle stages, closed off well only beaten less than 3L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。衝刺良佳。僅以不足三個馬位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled midfield, limited response when asked.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。末段對催策反應平平。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足，未能望空直至二百米處。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊，最後二百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。二百米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, there to turn, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，僅以頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway 400m out, unable to sustain and flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前。未能保持走勢，最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along to race in rear early stages, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，早段在推策下居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well, crowded closing stages and unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢，末段受擠迫，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat handy, kept on well to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走勢不俗。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden to maintain position 700m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居中間之後位置。七百米處受催策以保持位置。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, under pressure to settle in mid-field, smooth headway and ridden on bend, stayed on well but no match for winner.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，受催策下居中間位置。以暢順走勢上前，直路彎受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked pace, keen under restraint and forced to commence move out wide 600m out, good headway to take the lead 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。在約束下搶口。六百米處被迫開始上前，走外疊。以佳勢上前，三百米處取得領先。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened 150M, eased final 50M.
(Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。一百五十米處轉弱，最後五十米收慢。
（於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Hampered shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, weakened 500M, eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。五百米處轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped okay and led, traveled okay, weakened at the top of the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘尚可，領放，走勢不俗。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to chase leader from top of home straight, stuck to task but unable to bridge gap.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先兩駒。自直路初起在催策下追趕領放馬。持續力拼，但未能收窄距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat behind the lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居領放馬之後。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 350M, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, a bit closer on turn, 2 wide after passing 500M, no clear run early in straight, kept on evenly thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百米處後走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled towards rear, lay in inside 200M, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。最後二百米內閃。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail on bend, good headway early part of home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎移離內欄。直路早段以佳勢上前。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of the rear on the rail, was difficult to obtain clear running in the early straight, ran on nicely in the final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列之前位置，走內欄。直路早段難以望空。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 700M, 1/2L back turning in, took the lead 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W) 起步後不久與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後追近，入直路時落後半個馬位。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages and switched wide, under pressure 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口及移出外疊。五百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙及失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，落後三個半馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide behind midfield from 900M, angled out 600M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自九百米處起居中間之後位置，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, no clear run from 250M to 100M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處至一百米處之間未能望空。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear run final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米望空，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。二百米處追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Slow to begin, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘緩慢，留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 700m out, ran on well in home straight, lost out only narrowly in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處移離內欄。直路上以佳勢上前。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, bumped 250m out, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百五十米處發生碰撞。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, strong run final 400m to lead 75m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策。最後四百米走勢強勁。七十五米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, same position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W2W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with no cover better than midfield, moved a bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened approaching final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。趨近一百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Towards rear in race run at fast pace, weaved through runners to chase leaders 150m out, led on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，賽事步速甚快。一百五十米處在馬匹之間穿插上前，追趕領先馬匹。過終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked 400m out, strong challenge from runner-up in home straight, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。四百米處加速。直路上受亞軍馬匹的強勁挑戰。保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced better than midfield on outer, moved closer after passing 1200M, 2nd in the middle stages, 2 wide, bumped 300M, peaked near 200M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千二米處後追近。中段居第二位，走第二疊。三百米處發生碰撞。接近二百米處時未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, wider turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, sat 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace, three wide, ridden and quickly lost position turning into home straight, soon well held and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。轉入直路時受催策，但迅速失位。瞬即被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Clean jump, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front approaching 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide turning in, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (2nd last start.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘俐落，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（上仗跑獲亞軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W5W) Settled towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W5W) 居後列，走第三疊。保持走勢。
