runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Broke well, gradually settled 3-wide in worse than midfield with cover, quickened under pressure over 200M out reaching 2nd 100M out but never threatened the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。二百米處在催策下加速，一百米處進佔第二位，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away in line, restrained to race in midfield along the fence, responded only fairly in the straight. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。從未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival on turn, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎與對手並排領先。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, driven along 400m out, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Prominent early, 3-wide without cover rounding first bend, just over 2L off the pace in 4th in back straight, gave ground under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 早段居前列。首次轉彎時走第三疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上居第四位，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, ended up racing behind mid-division, failed to respond when driven along 400M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處對催策毫無反應。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Across to press leader early stages, tracked leaders 800m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 早段切入以追迫領放馬。八百米處跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速，其後迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Travelled mainly 3-wide without cover in better than midfield, commenced move entering home straight but unable to make any serious impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 大多居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時開始發力，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, smooth headway final bend, ran on strongly to lead top of home straight and soon in command, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以暢順走勢上前。以勁勢追前，直路初取得領先。瞬即控制大局，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W5W) Sat midfield 3 wide with cover, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, ran on well to challenge winner in home straight, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路上以佳勢上前挑戰頭馬，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Waited with from wide draw, keen early, headway wide final bend, stayed on, did best of those held up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留力候上。早段搶口。直路彎上前，走外疊。保持走勢，在留後馬匹中表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。衝勢良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W5W5W) From wide draw restrained to race in mid-division, caught racing wide throughout, didn't pick up 400M and failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，受約束，居中間位置。沿途走外疊。四百米處未能加速。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W3W4W) Jumped on terms and sat 3 wide with cover near the rear, made up stacks of ground to be the nearest on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, showed limited response in straight, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Sat towards rear on the rail, made steady progress in the home turn, ran on strongly under pressure to get the win in final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎穩步追前。在催策下走勢強勁，最後數步取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W1W) Sat behind the pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。保持強勁走勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide with cover off pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W4W3W4W) Settled midfield 3 wide with some cover, stayed on well, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，略有遮擋。保持佳勢，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W1W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, found rail near 1000M, saved ground on turn, hit the front 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近一千米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄疊節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer after passing 600M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
(Jockey dropped whip at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。
（於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and was sent forward, led, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Shifted out and made contact out of stalls, mid division, forced to steady on heels 1500m out, effort 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置。千五米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。三百米處發力上前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。直路初取得領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Box seat, ridden along to chase leaders 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。五百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直未能超越該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, moved up 600M to be tracking the pace turning into straight, kept on steadily to go 2nd mid-straight, no match for the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處上前，轉入直路時跟隨領放馬。保持穩勢，直路中段進佔第二位，但不敵遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。直路上對催策反應甚佳，二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, effort entering home straight, unable to challenge winner but stuck to task for clear second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時發力。未能挑戰頭馬，但持續力拼，帶離餘駒跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, improved after passing 800M, challenged the leader turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過八百米處後推進。入直路時挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，獲得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W5W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Guided to a position behind midfield, raced keenly early stages then swung wide over the home turn, failed to pick up pace on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，早段搶口。直路彎移出外疊。入直路時未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure and unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tightened at start and soon dropped to the rear, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受緊迫，瞬即墮居後列。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Held up in last pair, still in rear turning into home straight, unable to make any impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居最後兩位之內。轉入直路時仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 500M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, forward move to chase leaders 400m out, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前追趕領先馬匹。速度不足以展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, navigated through traffic in the Straight, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上在馬群中推進上前。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last pair turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide at rear, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Jumped on terms but soon dropped back to race at the back, had big task in hand 400M and couldn't go on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，但瞬即墮居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W2W2W) Jumped ok from gate 1 and settled midfield the fence, moved off the rail around 1100m, stuck to the task in a blanket finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W2W2W) 自第一檔出閘尚可，居中間位置，走內欄。約千一米處移離內欄。持續力拼，與多駒幾乎齊過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the fence, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W4W) Prominent early from a poor draw gradually settling in midfield, switched wide into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段居前列，逐漸居中間位置。入直路時移出外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, 3 wide from 1200M, 4-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自千二米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, driven along 400m out to chase leader, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Dipped when leaving the stalls, waited with in rear, unable to find clear room until 100m, hit the line nicely once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時將頭低俯，居後列，留力候上。未能望空直至一百米處，望空後隨即以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W3W4W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer after passing 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後追近。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, unable to quickened before running past a few beaten horses in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策，未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Towards rear, struggling and left well behind from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列。自直路初起掙扎上前，落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W4W) Held up last, driven along and outpaced middle stages, wide into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W4W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策及被拋離。入直路時走外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。轉入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched inside for clear run 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百米處移入內疊以望空。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled down in midfield racing keenly middle stages, held up for clear running 350-250M and again from 200M-150M before running on nicely late stages to claim 4th. Could do better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。三百五十米處至二百五十米處之間及二百米處至一百五十米處之間兩度受困而未能望空。末段以佳勢上前，取得第四名。本應可有更佳發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Not the quickest out, settled off pace on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘並非最快，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Bumped leaving stall, held up, plenty to do top of home straight, angled out at 300m line, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留後。直路初落後甚遠。三百米處向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, held up, headway up inside rail over 300m out, no further impression final 100m, short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留後。三百米處沿欄追前。最後一百米再無表現。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Began well enough, raced keenly early stages and ended up settling outside the lead, held 2nd spot from 500M to 200M and had no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘不俗，早段搶口，其後居領放馬外側。自五百米處起至二百米處保持居第二位。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, no clear run early in straight, found daylight 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back from wide draw, settled near the rear and 6Ls off leader 400M, made some progress and wasn't beaten far at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居後列。四百米處落後領放馬六個馬位。末段略為追前，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎略為追前。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Settled back in the field 5-6Ls off leaders, pace very slow for the first half of the race, failed to make up ground in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居後列，落後領先馬匹五至六個馬位。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。直路上未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Taken back to last from the widest barrier trailing the field to home straight, ran on past well-beaten ones inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路前尾隨馬群。最後一百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, lay in in the early Straight, gave ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初內閃。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride towards the rear, brought wide into straight before running on moderately to the finish. Posed no threat to first three however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。入直路時移出外疊。保持不俗走勢至終點，但未能對頭三名馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Held up last after crowded leaving stalls, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，其後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for room turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, forced to angle wide for clear run 150m out, quickened well final 100m to lead late on, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。一百五十米處被迫移出外疊以望空。最後一百米加速良佳，末段進佔領先位置，從容取勝。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Cool Aza Beel from Jacquetta, a daughter of Encosta de Lago. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. The fellow was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished second under pressure, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 7. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 7Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Cool Aza Beel之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「拿高」(Encosta de Lago)。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。9月7日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，起步居後，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬七個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield in 5th spot, ran home one paced final 400M. Never going the pace to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前的第五位。最後四百米保持同速。從未能加速上前展開挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Midfield on rail early stages, made headway 1400M out to be 2L 3rd onto home bend, badly baulked for a run after straightening until the 300M, ran on to hold every chance throughout final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間位置，走內欄。千四米處上前。開始轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路後嚴重受困直至三百米處。末段沿途保持走勢，一度甚具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, bumped 700m out, good headway on bend, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。七百米處碰撞他駒。直路彎追前甚多。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, finished off strongly to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W1W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat last, made no ground. (See Incident Report)
(Multi-limb lameness.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（多肢不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Mustered no early pace and settled 3rd last about 15Ls or so off the leader 600m out, peeled out widest turning in for home, stormed home to score with sufficient speed in the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 欠缺前速，居尾三位置，六百米處落後領放馬約十五個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊。賽事步速頗快，末段衝刺凌厲，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Waited with in rear, severely checked 400m out when trying to improve, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處在嘗試推進之際大力勒避。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat last, able to pick off weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居包尾位置。末段超越已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards rear on the inside, angled out of a run on straightening, ran on quite well under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走內疊。入直路時向外移出取位。在催策下走勢不俗，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) In midfield throughout, kept on steadily under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 沿途居中間位置。在催策下保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier travelling one back 3-wide without cover early stages, made swift headway inside the 1000M to lead rounding home bend, found no extra and swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處迅速上前，轉直路彎時取得領先。最後一百米再無餘力及被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, headway 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處追前。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sluggish start, shifted in and bumped out of stalls, in rear, good headway 500m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處追前甚多，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Began smartly, took the lead, shared lead with rival in the middle stages, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段與對手並排領先。接近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened from the 600M. (Unacceptable Performance, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 居前列。自六百米處起轉弱。（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。保持走勢，最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Broke well settling just off the pace in 2nd, came to join race leader rounding home bend holding every chance in straight until unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後的第二位。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百五十米後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked 300m out and three lengths clear 100m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 全程領放。三百米處加速。一百米處帶離三個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Showed good pace to lead, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, finished off strongly, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。衝刺強勁，僅以一馬頸位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, trailed the field most of the way and the widest into straight, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多，大部分途程尾隨馬群。入直路時走最外疊。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, pushed along when checked briefly 500m out, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。五百米處受推策，一度勒避。最後三百米掙扎上前及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。欠缺速度以展開挑戰。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, ended up racing near last, had some work to do 400M but responded only fairly to pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field from about 1300M out, made modest progress past well-beaten horses in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留後。自約千三米處起尾隨馬群。直路上略為追前，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded on jumping, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 躍出時受擠迫，居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) In rear after sluggish start, under pressure 500m out, switched inside for clear run 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步緩慢，其後居後列。五百米處受催策。三百五十米處向內移入以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Recovered quickly from moderate start to lead after the first 100M setting a sound pace, ceded advantage for 2nd spot onto home bend, remained prominent in 3rd into straight but folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，迅速恢復走勢，過了首一百米後取得領先，以快步速領放。開始轉直路彎時被超越，居第二位。入直路時居前列第三位，但最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure to hold position 500m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策以保持位置。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, took the early lead, headed 1150M, allowed rival to cross near 950M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。一千一百五十米處被超越。接近九百五十米處時讓對手過頭。中段落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。三百米處未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W7W) Jumped only fairly, settled down behind midfield 5Ls back, swung wide for home before running on at same pace early straight, eased when no chance.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W7W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位。轉直路彎時移出外疊。直路初上前，保持同速。在爭勝無望時收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, closed off fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般，對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，落後五個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in midfield on rail, kept on in home straight until fading steadily inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上保持走勢，直至最後二百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shifted in on jumping and bumped, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field in rail position, good and smooth headway on final bend, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎順勢追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Shifted in at start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out approaching 300M, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on very strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。趨近三百米處時向外移出。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處帶頭。末段保持凌厲走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4Ls back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent early, gradually shifted back to worse than midfield in 9th, inconvenienced when tempo slackened 800M out, baulked until clear run 300M out near the centre of the track, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，逐漸墮居中間之後的第九位。八百米處在步速減慢時受妨礙。受困直至三百米處望空，靠近跑道中央競跑。末段以穩勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Out with rest, raced behind midfield, nearer to the middle track, 4 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。中段落後四個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield one off the fence, one paced to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along on bend, tended to hang right in home straight, made up several places.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎受推策。直路上傾向內閃。末段追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, ridden top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Waited with towards rear, raced keenly throughout, dropped to last place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初墮退至包尾位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually settling in 8th for cover just inside the 1100M, slightly further back in quickened pace 800M out, ran on steadily inside final 400M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速。跑過千一米處後逐漸居第八位以取得遮擋。八百米處略為進一步落後步速加快的領放馬。最後四百米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well before being restrained to a midfield position 4-5Ls off the pace, fought on steadily final 400M but was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。最後四百米持續力拼，但一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, ended up racing at the rear group, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quicken enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後頗遠，但加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced in rear, headway out wide 800m out, ridden 400m out, ran on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列。八百米處追前，走外疊。四百米處受催策，以佳勢上前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in last few from a wide barrier and waited with on rail, commenced move on the inside after straightening, reached 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後居最後數位之內，留力候上，走內欄。入直路後沿內疊開始上前。末段跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to hold position by halfway, bumped 300m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。半程起未能保持位置。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear, in similar position turning for home, ran home only fairly. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時位置相若。末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 500m out, ran green, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處受推策，走勢稚嫩，超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Held up from wide draw, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。最後三百米掙扎上前，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 500m out, lost touch final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 600m out, short of room top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。直路初空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, no clear run until 200M, ran on well afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，其後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, stayed on well for pressure final 300m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) In rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, stayed on well once clear final 200m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百米望空後保持佳勢，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W) Broke well before settling towards rear in 8th or 9th, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，其後居後列第八或第九位。直路上受催策上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, stayed on well along the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。沿內疊保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped on terms, close up with leaders early stages before dropping back to race ahead of midfield passing 700M, ran on well early straight but run ended 150M from home and faded away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段緊隨領先馬匹。跑過七百米處時墮居中間之前位置。直路初走勢良佳，但一百五十米處無以為繼，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch, headway to challenge 200m out, every chance and led briefly final 100m, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處追前以展開挑戰。最後一百米一度取得領先，末段保持走勢，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along 700m out, short of room from 350m out to 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受推策。三百五十米處至二百米處之間空位不足。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in mid-division, shuffled back on bend, made up some ground home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路彎墮退。直路上略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, stuck to inside rail, under pressure over 300m out, unable to quicken, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，固守內欄。三百米處受催策，但未能加速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Began only fairly from the widest draw, raced in midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, dropped towards rear approaching 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。趨近五百米處時墮居後列。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) In rear, pushed along from top of home straight, some late headway, lacked pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。自直路初起受推策。末段略為追前，但速度不足以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, stayed on under pressure final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, no clear run over the final 150M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。最後一百五十米未能望空，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Towards rear of mid-field, headway into third 150m out, stayed on but no danger to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處上前進佔第三位。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Very slowly away, soon recovered to rear end of the field, in a similar position into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘非常緩慢，瞬即回復走勢，居馬群後列。入直路時位置相若。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Moderately away, raced in midfield, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, good headway to challenge leader top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。以佳勢上前，直路初挑戰領放馬。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, made good progress when asked near 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走勢尚可。接近一百五十米處時在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Gradually taken back to last few after beginning from a wide barrier, one of the widest into home straight, inconvenienced for a stride just inside the 300M, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居最後數位之內。入直路時走最外疊。三百米處一度受妨礙。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Towards rear, wide into home straight, stayed on late, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Travelled 4-wide without cover in back straight, obtained cover 3-wide rounding home bend, carried very wide entering home straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 對面直路上走第四疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時走第三疊，取得遮擋。入直路時被帶出大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From an awkward draw caught out on a limb, boxed on solidly considering the tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Crowded leaving stalls and also shuffled back around halfway, towards rear, stayed on from 400m out, moved into third 150m out, no further impression on front two closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘時受擠迫。大約半程時墮居後列。自四百米處起持續上前，一百五十米處居第三位。末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, asked for effort 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Held up from wide draw, always in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。一直居後列。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from wide draw and raced in last pair, well held from early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居最後兩位內。自直路初起所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide after passing 700M, 5 to 6 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。跑過七百米處後走第三疊。直路彎落後五至六個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W5W) Settled in midfield mainly 3-wide with cover, commenced move on top of home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure inside final 200M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W5W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎早段開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。最後二百米在催策下追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持強勁走勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W3W) Shortly after the start was tight for galloping room and was then ridden conservatively, responded well under reminders in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W3W) 起步後不久受緊迫，繼而留後。直路上對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls and crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時被碰撞，其後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, lay out throughout the middle stages, angled out 400M, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。中段沿途外閃。四百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, hard ridden after passing 450M, wide into straight, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, held up at the early Straight, no clear run until 150M, finished off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。直路初受困，未能望空直至一百五十米處。衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, had to angle out for run 200m out, stayed on but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。二百米處須向外移出取位。保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, rail position throughout, ridden from top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置。沿途走內欄。自直路初起受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE CHINESE RECREATION CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中華游樂會挑戰盃（讓賽）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on outer, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至二百米處。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。跑過二百五十米處後望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Reserved in a position behind midfield, picked up in good style 300M, charged home late but couldn't get past winner. Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置。三百米處加速良佳。末段衝刺強勁，但未能超越頭馬，在力拼下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Rail position in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米衝刺強勁，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W) Four wide in mid-field, improved to chase leader 800m out to save ground, challenged and led narrowly 250m out, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W) 居中間位置，走第四疊。八百米處上前追趕領放馬以節省腳程。二百五十米處展開挑戰，以短距離領先。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, commenced move out wide 700m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。七百米處開始發力，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W3W) Eased back to sit in a rearward position 7Ls off the fast pace, shuffled back to last spot making the home turn, brought wide to challenge and finished off mildly to take a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 收慢留居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。移出外疊以展開挑戰。末段衝刺普通，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) From wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear, had plenty to make up 400M but failed to pick up pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Restrained to race in second half of the field, travelled keenly, lost cover from 900M strode forward to chase leaders, run ended mid-straight and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 受約束，居後半馬群中，跑來搶口。自九百米處起展步上前追趕領先馬匹，失去遮擋。直路中段無以為繼，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made some use take up a position outside the lead, failed to respond to riding in the home straight, weakened badly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 略受催策上前，佔取領放馬外側位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。末段嚴重轉弱，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced keenly behind leaders, forward move to challenge 300m out, every chance, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹之後，搶口。三百米處上前展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W2W) Went forward tracking leader, pace slow middle stages, led 300M out before keeping on well to hold rivals at bay. (Trainer attributed the improved performance being up in distance and being able to race on the pace.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 上前跟隨領放馬。賽事中段步速緩慢。三百米處取得領先，其後保持佳勢，力拒對手勝出。（練馬師將此駒的進步表現歸因於增程角逐，並能夠居前競跑。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail after beginning from a wide barrier, travelled keenly from 1300M out while trailing the field on rail, detached early in straight but ran past well-beaten runners under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後，走內欄。自千三米處起搶口，沿欄尾隨馬群。直路初被拋離，但最後一百五十米在催策下超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, carried wider 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處被帶出較外疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) From draw 11 dropped back to race near last 8Ls off leader in a fast run race, switched wide 450M to commence his run, stayed on well enough to take 3rd without threatening first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 自第十一檔出閘後墮居接近包尾位置，在快步速下落後領放馬八個馬位。四百五十米處移出外疊以開始上前。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover early stages, settled with cover middle stages, forced to steady 450m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段取得遮擋。四百五十米處被迫收慢，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled just over 3L back in 5th on rail, obtained a clear run 200M out, ran on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第五位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。二百米處望空。在催策下上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, still 8 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時仍落後八個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W2W) Tracked leader along the inside, responded well to be challenging for the lead from 300M, kept battling to the line final stages but was always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走內疊。自三百米處起對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先。末段持續力拼至終點，但一直未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 550m out, gave ground final 300m, forced to steady 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，其後受催策，領放。五百五十米處加速。最後三百米墮退。二百米處被迫收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自直路初起沿欄展開挑戰。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近最後一百米時。保持佳勢至終點，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, dropped to rear of mid-field on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。直路彎墮居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，終點線上取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled 3-wide in rear of midfield from a poor draw, inconvenienced 350M out, ran on dourly under pressure to gain upper hand close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百五十米處受妨礙。末段在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, switched out top of Straight, stay on well. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居尾列。直路初向外移出。保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, kept on nicely when asked, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a nose.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。在催策下保持佳勢。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以一馬鼻位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W2W) Moved forward tracking leaders, always in touch, couldn't accelerate when the race got serious 450M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W2W) 上前跟隨領先馬匹，一直居啣接位置。四百五十米處在關鍵時刻未能加速上前，只能保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always thereabouts with rails run, taken some 2L back in 3rd 1200M out, commenced move on straightening and hit the front 300M out, soon drew clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置，走內欄。千二米處留居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。入直路時開始發力，三百米處取得領先。瞬即帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W3W3W) Rail position in mid-field, switched 1200m out to make run 800m out, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W3W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千二米處轉換跑線，八百米處取位上前。六百米處受推策追趕領先馬匹，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From a wide draw taken back to last, 10Ls off the pace on settling, had big task in hand top of straight but failed to make real progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，落後領放馬十個馬位。直路初仍落後甚遠。末段無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, followed winner through 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, crowded and checked 700m out, dropped to rear into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受擠迫及勒避。入直路時墮居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 500m out for clear run top of home straight, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄，直路初望空。末段走勢良佳，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m but lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, cleared 300M, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, hard ridden after passing 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢上前，一百五十米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但仍保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat rear, commenced to improve from near the 800M, held up at the early Straight, closed off strongly (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居後列。自接近八百米處起開始推進。直路初受困。衝刺強勁。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W3W) Sat towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out after passing 500M, no daylight early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段難以望空。跑過二百五十米處後望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped back to the rear on jumping from a wide draw, had a ground saving trip on the inside, had some work to do 400M, closed off fastest to finish a close 5th, nearest at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置，走內疊節省腳程。四百米處仍落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide, driven 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sluggish start, raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, one paced and unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, good headway around field to lead over 200m out, challenged 100m out, ran on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。其後繞過馬群，追前甚多。二百米處取得領先。一百米處受挑戰。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, outpaced in rear, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，未能跟上步速。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, 10 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。入直路時落後十個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide early, began to improve from the 900M, closed off strongly, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自九百米處起開始推進。衝刺強勁，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (4W3W2W4W) Settled towards rear, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well in straight to grab 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(4W3W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時受催策。直路上走勢良佳，末段跑獲第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W2W6W) Sat last 2 wide, could only pass some weakened rivals in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W2W6W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。直路上僅能超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run and made contact early in straight, cleared 300M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，與對手互相觸碰。三百米處望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly and settled near the rear, pushed wide after 600M before running home fairly in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。過了六百米處後受推策，走外疊。直路上衝刺一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 2 wide on turn, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and soon detached from the field, dropped out of contention alarmingly from midway. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，瞬即被馬群拋離。自中段起急劇墮退，再無爭勝機會。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, taken wider 900m out, shifted right in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。九百米處被帶出更外疊。直路上向內斜跑。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W3W) Went forward under 10lb claimer and held the lead first turn, settled in 2nd from 1100M, fought hard to stay in contention early straight before weakening 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 在獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎下上前，首個彎位取得領先。自千一米處起居第二位。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W5W) Settled behind midfield 3-wide, pace very slow in the first half of the race, couldn't improve position when driven along home turn, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢，直路彎受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W4W5W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W4W5W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and lost balance, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out and bumped, strong run to lead 300m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時失蹄，失去平衡，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處向外移出以望空，與對手互相碰撞。走勢強勁，三百米處帶頭。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped to rear middle stages, struggling in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段墮居後列。直路上掙扎上前，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, showed good speed to lead, soon joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by runner-up 200m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展現甚快前速領放。直路初瞬即被對手追上。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, raced prominently, briefly checked 500m out, twice bumped 350m out to 200m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列。五百米處一度勒避。三百五十米處至二百米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well in straight, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。中段輕鬆領放。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。直路上保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W3W) Tracked leaders, effort 300m out, led 150m out, in control final 100m and won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處取得領先。最後一百米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W2W) Sat midfield, raced wide until 800M, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處前走外疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting in for cover in 3L 4th onto first bend, further off the lead in increased tempo in back straight, renewed effort over 400M out and hit the front 200M out, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。開始轉首個彎位時向內移入以取得遮擋，居第四位，落後三個馬位。對面直路上步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。四百米處重新發力。二百米處取得領先，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Up with early pace before easing back to race ahead of midfield, had some difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-200M then attacked the line well to be nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段跟上前速，其後收慢留居中間之前位置。三百米處至二百米處之間頗為難以望空，其後以佳勢衝刺。過終點時最為接近。
