runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Blundered on jumping, chased leaders in 3rd, driven along 400M and moved up to 2nd nearing 200M, couldn't get closer to the winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 躍出時失蹄。追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。四百米處受催策，接近二百米處時上前進佔第二位。末段未能追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Went forward and settled just off the pace early stages before drifting back to a position ahead of midfield halfway, fought on one paced to the line final 300M and not making ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段上前，居領放馬稍後位置。半程時墮居中間之前位置。最後三百米力拼，保持同速，未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Crossed to the fence after the jump before settling down towards the rear, had some work to do turning home, closed off best to take 5th
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 躍出後切入內欄，其後居後列。轉直路彎時落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off leader, responded fairly passing 400M and not able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。跑過四百米處時對催策反應一般。未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢良佳，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約七個馬位。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon taken well back from the widest draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, was difficult to obtain clear running in the middle of the straight and again near 100M, made good ground over concluding stages and got the 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路中段難以望空，接近一百米處時再度難以望空。末段追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初望空，末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked one length clear top of home straight, stayed on well but headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭。直路初加速帶離一個馬位。保持佳勢，但終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，取得領先。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Across from widest draw to lead, set strong pace, joined and headed 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後切入內疊，以快步速領放。四百米處被追上及超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Pressed forward from a middle draw eventually joining leader 2-wide on first bend 1200M out, became one-out-one-back in 3th 700M out, ran home one-paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策上前，千二米處首個彎位追上領放馬，走第二疊。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, chased leader, ridden to press leader 400m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與一駒互相碰撞，追趕領放馬。四百米處在催策下追迫領放馬。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped nicely, sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前帶頭。保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, 2 wide from 600M, wider turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百米處。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W4W) Waited with in rear, commenced move out wide without cover 900m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處開始上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Waited with in rear, some headway out wide middle stages, sustained headway in home straight but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。中段略為追前，走外疊。直路上持續上前，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled just behind midfield, moved closer over the home turn to be 3Ls off leader 400M, fought hard in the straight couldn't find the extra gear to challenge first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 居中間稍後位置。直路彎追近。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。直路上力拼，但未能加速以挑戰頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, chased that rival down from 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，自三百米處起追趕該駒。以勁勢上前，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced keenly early stages and sat rear of midfield, made up some steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段搶口，居中間之後位置。穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W5W) Began from a wide barrier, gradually taken back to wide in last few, widest runner turning for home, ran on past well-beaten horses down the centre of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居最後數位之內，走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。直路上在跑道中央超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, dropped towards rear on turn, no clear run early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路初未能望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in midfield on rail, saved ground turning in for home, faded steadily inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。最後一百五十米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 700m out but no response, pulled up from 500m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策，但毫無反應。自五百米處起收停。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths back, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步不久發生觸碰，居後列，落後六個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路初對催策毫無反應，最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still plenty to do 400m out, strong and sustained run to lead late on, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後頗遠。持續以勁勢上前，末段取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out top of the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路初向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped and unbalanced early on, outpaced in rear, last and struggling on bend, stayed on final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡，未能跟上步速，居後列。直路彎居包尾位置，掙扎上前。最後二百米保持走勢及超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, good headway on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎追前甚多。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下率先衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat rear, switched out entering the Straight, made some ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居後列。入直路時向外移出。自後列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, held up last, ridden along 600m out, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to chase leader 1000m out, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處推進上前，追趕領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。保持走勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Reserved in a second half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, held up on the home turn when the race got serious, into clear running 350M and finished off well to get up in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 留居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。賽事進入關鍵階段時在直路彎受困。三百五十米處望空。衝刺良佳，末段取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Keen early, tracked pace, unable to match winner from 200m out but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段搶口，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起未能抗衡頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 550m out, stayed on well to close on leaders late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處向外移出取位。末段保持佳勢，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from inside draw, obtained a position in midfield, 4Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最內檔出閘迅速，居中間位置。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W7W) Raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W7W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W2W3W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Restrained to race towards the rear 6-7La back, little change in position to the straight, closed off well enough to finish 4th, only a head behind the 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 受約束，居後列，落後六至七個馬位。入直路前居相若位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲第四名，僅落後亞軍一馬頭位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in mid-field on the inside, saved ground on turn, blocked off when going for run 350m out, clear run 200m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處取位時受困。二百米處望空，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in rear of midfield on the rail, drifted slightly worse approaching home bend, ran on from 8th into straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。趨近直路彎時略為墮後。入直路時自第八位追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken well back early from a wide barrier, ridden forward to reach 9th towards rear inside the 700M remaining 3-wide without cover to straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段遙居於後。受催策上前，七百米處進佔後列的第九位。直路前仍走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped in line, dropped back to sit behind mid-division, brought widest for his challenge in the straight, closed off well to go 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，墮居中間之後位置。直路上移至最外疊展開挑戰。衝刺良佳，接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly settling over 2L back in 6th on rail, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend switching off the rail for a run, ran on steadily inside final 150M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居第六位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠，移離內欄取位。最後一百五十米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, 4 lengths back on turn, closed off well to take 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段留居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，過終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled 3-wide without cover behind midfield, one of the widest when further away turning in for home, ran on well in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉入直路時落後更遠，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。直路上以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sent forward taking the lead nearing 800M, hung in under pressure from 500M, shifted considerable ground in the run home but was always going well enough to secure victory. (Warning placed on its racing manner.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;接近八百米處時受催策上前取得領先。自五百米處起在催策下內閃。末段大幅度斜跑，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Pressed leader, under pressure 500m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
(Epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。
（會厭被覆蓋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat in front of midfield 3 off the outside rail, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之前位置，走外欄第四疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped nicely and shared lead, stuck on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘迅速，並排領先。保持普通走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from poor draw settling 3-wide without cover in 4th about 1L off the pace, came to join the leader on top of home bend sharing lead into straight, unable to sustain effort and weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第四位，落後領放馬約一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎早段追上領放馬。入直路時並排領先，但無以為繼，最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, travelled keenly in the early and middle stages, 3/4L back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走第二疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後四分三馬位。直路早段對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced prominently on the stands' rail, took the lead 300M, kept on very well to hold off the challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走外欄。三百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢力拒對手的挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Took up a forward position as expected, fought hard passing 400M to stay in contention, inconvenienced near 200M when winner hung in, beaten to 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;如預期般佔取前列位置。跑過四百米處時力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近二百米處時在頭馬內閃之際受妨礙。接近終點時洩氣，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held narrow running early stages, some 1L off the pace on stands rail onto course proper, held every chance inside final 200M but unable to sustain effort close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段以短距離領先。跑離分支直路時落後領放馬約一個馬位，走外欄。最後二百米一度甚具爭勝機會，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to narrow lead well off the rail from the 4 draw before settling 2-wide as joint leader 800M out, held position under pressure early in straight until swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第四檔出閘，受催策，以短距離領先，走外疊。八百米處並排領先，走第二疊。直路早段在催策下保持位置，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, soon in a prominent position racing down the center of track, couldn't quicken as well as the leaders final 200M. Comfortably held in 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，瞬即居前列，在跑道中央競跑。最後二百米加速力不及領先馬匹。未能追近，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, raced towards centre of course, pushed along 400m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處受推策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Across to press leader, challenged leader turning into home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。入直路時挑戰領放馬。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed customary early speed to lead, kept going well passing 300M, was strongly challenged by rival late stages but managed to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現一貫前速，帶頭。跑過三百米處時保持佳勢。末段受對手強勁挑戰，但成功保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時被帶出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, without cover halfway out, taken wider on bend, eased 350m out when jockey was concerned with his action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處在騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good ground early part of the Straight, just one pace late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段追前甚多，但末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Crowded on jumping from a wide draw then taken back to race at the rear, ran on fairly without threat to the leaders. Had difficulty obtaining clear running near 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘時受擠迫，其後留居後列。走勢一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。接近一百米處時難以望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay, peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗，一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Travelled keenly in rear of midfield on rail, pulled closer rounding home bend sharing 6th into straight, kept on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄，搶口。轉直路彎時追近，入直路時並列第六位。保持穩勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Crowded and unbalanced at start travelling wide without cover throughout, improved steadily to 2L 4th 600M out but lost position entering straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫及失去平衡。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處以穩勢進佔第四位，落後兩個馬位，但入直路時失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leaders on rails, weakened out of contention under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米在催策下轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞。跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, momentarily racing wide without cover before ridden along to be outside the leader, battled on well but just couldn't hold off the winner over final 50m (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，一度走外疊，沒有遮擋。其後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Well there from a low draw, snatched up when crossed on rail 600M out, angled out from 2L 3rd 450M out for a clear run into straight but could only keep on at the one pace without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自內檔出閘，居好位。六百米處在內欄被過頭之際勒避。四百五十米處居第三位，落後兩個馬位，向外移出以於入直路時望空，但其後僅能保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From wide draw ended up chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, couldn't quicken enough on straightening, always held by leaders in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時加速力不足。末段一直未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from the one draw settling just off the pace, obtained cover one back behind leader over 600M out, angled out to challenge upon straightening but faded steadily inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置。六百米處落後領放馬一個馬位，有遮擋。入直路時向外移出以展開挑戰，但最後一百米逐漸力竭。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Blue Point from Girl Guide, a daughter of Churchill Downs. Horses by the same sire include Invictus Dragon and Colourful King. This fellow had four starts for one win (a class 3 over 1400m) and one placing. He was given one trial in Hong Kong. He sat last and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 21. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「蔚藍海角」(Blue Point)之後，在港同父馬包括「龍傲綾羅」及「顏色之皇」等駒，生母出自Churchill Downs。來港前在澳洲四戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1400米三班賽。抵港後試閘一次。最近9月21日出試從化草地1000米，早段居後，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Crowded at start, made headway from midfield early to join race leader 600M out, shared pace until finding no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段自中間位置追前，六百米處與領放馬並跑。並排領先，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded after the start, soon moved forward and vied for the lead, couldn't go on mid-straight and weakened. (Jockey - disadvantaged when pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，瞬即上前爭奪領先。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下受追迫而不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw to share the pace racing very wide, obtained 2-wide position in front coming onto first turn 600M out, hung on under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策上前，並排領先，走大外疊。六百米處開始轉首個彎位時取得領先，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced 3 wide towards rear, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up last after slowly away, still in last place 400m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢後留居包尾位置。四百米處仍居包尾位置。最後二百米自後列追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Prominent early, unable to sustain and dropped away swiftly in the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;早段居前列。末段無以為繼，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms, settled towards the back of the field in 13th 6-7Ls off, did best work final 250M but failed to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居後列第十三位，落後六至七個馬位。最後二百五十米表現最佳，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Soon dropped to the rear, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;瞬即墮居後列。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Close up to leaders early before settling behind mid-pack in middle stages, stayed on steadily final 200M under big weight but never troubled leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段緊隨領先馬匹，其後於中段居中間之後位置。最後二百米在負重磅下保持穩勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Driven along and outpaced early stages, briefly short of room 350m out, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。三百五十米處一度空位不足。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Away well but restrained early to be last in the field, ran past a few tired rivals in the final stages (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，但早段受約束，居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, travelled smoothly, closed off nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。走勢暢順。衝刺良佳，僅未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Became unbalanced after the start, showed pace on his debut to be racing close up behind leaders, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a pleasing 3rd on debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後失去平衡。今仗初出展現前速，緊隨領先馬匹。最後三百米持續力拼，跑獲季軍，首戰表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; From draw 1 slotted into a midfield position, responded well when driven out 350M, lay in final 300M and ended up towards the far rail. Kept going well to line and not beaten far by the placegetters
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第一檔出閘，居中間位置。三百五十米處受力策，反應良佳。最後三百米內閃，靠近內欄競跑。保持佳勢至終點，落後頭三名馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初移出外疊以望空。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped fairly, moved up to settle just off leaders, responded well to pressure 300M challenging for the lead, peaked on his run passing 100M and outsprinted by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘一般，上前居領先馬匹稍後位置。三百米處對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先。跑過一百米處時未能再增速，被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier to soon take up running on the rail, led until joined 600M out, unable to sustain effort and swamped 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至六百米處被追上。其後未能保持走勢，一百五十米處被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, driven along 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Led early, ceded advantage for one-back 2nd after the first 200M, re-gained lead in home straight 300M out kicking over 2L clear over 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段領先，過了首二百米後被超越，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上三百米處重奪領先位置。一百五十米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a fast pace in middle stages, led the field until headed 250M out and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段以快步速領放。帶頭競跑，直至二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米被後上馬匹過頭，失去三甲位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded on jumping, stayed in touch with leaders just 2Ls away, couldn't quicken enough when the race got serious 400M, only held ground at best in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;躍出時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹，僅落後兩個馬位。四百米處馬群加速時加速力不足。末段表現最佳時僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off from a middle draw, came under pressure to challenge inside final 300M holding every chance, only to be outsprinted close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自中檔出閘後從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米受催策以展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 14 went forward to be racing with leaders, responded well up the stand's rail final 200M, just denied.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第十四檔出閘，上前與領先馬匹並跑。最後二百米沿外欄競跑時對催策反應良佳。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent, improved to lead 500m out, pressed on 350m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。推進上前，五百米處取得領先。三百五十米處受追迫。一百米處被頭馬超越。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 50M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W) 受催策上前帶頭。保持走勢，最後五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat on pace on the stands' rail, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，走外欄。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat last, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居包尾位置。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced on outer in mid-field, good headway to challenge 150m out, ran on strongly as first two drew clear, narrow winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。其後追前甚多，一百五十米處展開挑戰。末段走勢強勁，與第二位馬匹雙雙帶離餘駒。以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Raced in touch with leaders, smooth headway halfway out, pressed on 200m out, strong run to win going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以暢順走勢上前。二百米處受催策。末段走勢強勁，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Began well from gate 1, taken back to race behind midfield on the middle track, 2 to 3 lengths back at 400M, hard ridden from 250M and made some progress, no extra final 50M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;自第一檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後兩至三個馬位。自二百五十米處起受力策，略為追前。最後五十米再無餘力。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent, pushed up to lead 400m out, ran on well but joined by winner 100m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。四百米處在推策下取得領先。保持佳勢，但一百米處被頭馬追上，不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, angled out 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began only fairly, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) From draw 1 obtained a position just ahead of midfield, close enough to leaders turning for home, fought on well to gain lead near 150M, couldn't hold off winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間稍前位置。轉入直路時緊隨領先馬匹。以佳勢力拼，接近一百五十米處時取得領先。末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 2 wide at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, checked near 250M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。接近二百五十米處時勒避。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初追前甚多。一百五十米處未能再加速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, race keenly throughout, headway on bend to follow winner through 600m out, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途搶口。直路彎上前，六百米處跟隨頭馬推進。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W3W) Dropped out in rail position from wide draw, pushed along wide for clear run 500m out, quickened early in home straight, hung in but strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，走內欄。五百米處受推策以望空，走外疊。直路早段加速，內閃，但走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，帶返終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; From the stand-side draw stayed close enough to leaders, lay in final 500M, kept on well under top weight to take 2nd but safely held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自最外檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。最後五百米內閃。在負頂磅下保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 4 lengths turning in, kicked clear early in straight, kept on very well, easily scored, very impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四個馬位。直路早段加速帶離。末段保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆掄元，表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, was repeatedly denied for clear running in the home straight before easing off final 150M when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上一再未能望空。最後一百五十米在再無爭逐機會下收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced prominently on the outside, took the lead near 1150M, found rail near 950M, led by a length turning in, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走外疊。接近一千一百五十米處時取得領先。接近九百五十米處切入內欄。入直路時領先一個馬位。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced prominently, 2 wide, steadied near 700M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時收慢。轉入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百五十米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped at the start then bustled along to take the lead from draw 11, soon pressed by rival on straightening, lost lead nearing 200M but kept battling to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 自第十一檔起步時發生碰撞，其後受催策，取得領先。入直路時瞬即受對手追迫。接近二百米處時失去領先位置，但持續力拼，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, took the early lead, headed near 850M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead 300M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近八百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。三百米處重奪領先位置。保持甚佳走勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and chased leader, tightened up briefly 500m out, ridden along behind leaders 300m out, stayed on to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，追趕領放馬。五百米處一度受緊迫。三百米處受催策，居領先馬匹之後。末段保持走勢，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Raced prominently, wandered under pressure from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 居前列。自三百米處起在催策下走勢欠規矩。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, raced prominently, took the lead 250M, kept on well, just able to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，居前列。二百五十米處取得領先。其後保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Badly crowded at start losing ground, travelled towards rear on rail some 6L off the pace in back straight, snuck closer home turn, ran on well down the inside to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，失地。對面直路上居後列，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。直路彎追近。在內疊以佳勢追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in rear and waited with, ran on well down the centre of home straight to snatch 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上在跑道中央以佳勢上前。末段跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail from moderate start, made gradual headway from the 600M to reach 3L 7th into straight, quickened well inside final 150M to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步普通，居後列，走內欄。自六百米處起逐漸上前，入直路時進佔第七位，落後三個馬位。最後一百五十米加速良佳，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Began well from a poor draw gradually settling over 4-wide towards rear of bunched field, commenced move 650M out swinging the widest into straight, ran on under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，逐漸居馬群後列，走第四疊。六百五十米處開始上前。入直路時移出最外疊。末段在催策下上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, 2 wide from 600M, finished off strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 150M, finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, tight for room when challenging up rail over 200m out, clear 150m out and stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。二百米處在沿欄展開挑戰之際受緊迫。一百五十米處望空。末段保持佳勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Ole Kirk from Cheyenne Sue, a daughter of Zizou. Horses by the same sire include Gallant Design and Extraordinary Gall. This fellow had five starts for one win (a 2yo handicap over 1000m) and one placing. The fellow was given five trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished second under slightly pressure, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, over 800m on turf in Conghua on May 18. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished ninth under slight pressure, beaten by 4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「童夢奇才」(Ole Kirk)之後，在港同父馬包括「創寶駒」及「非凡勇士」等駒，生母出自「吉作」(Zizou)。來港前在澳洲五戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1000米兩歲讓磅賽。抵港後五次試閘一次上名。5月18日出試從化草地800米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第九名，落後頭馬四個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, briefly hampered 500m out, lost touch in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處一度受阻礙。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Wide early, dropped to settle in rear of mid-field with cover 800m out, ridden top of home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 早段走外疊。八百米處墮居中間之後位置，有遮擋。直路初受催策，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 700m out, unable to improve position, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策。其後未能推進上前，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped ok and settled midfield one off the rail, angled out for a run 600M out, lacked a finishing effort and outsprinted (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出以取位。衝刺乏力，被超越。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; In rear after sluggish start, switched towards centre of course for clear run 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步緩慢，居後列。三百米處移向跑道中央以望空。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Broke ok from gate 5, settled towards the rear with cover, switched course 250M out, swept past them and never looked back from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)自第五檔出閘尚可，居後列，有遮擋。二百五十米處轉換跑線。末段超越其他對手，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走勢暢順。未能望空直至二百米處。末段未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout without cover in mid division, strong run in home straight to lead 200m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上走勢強勁，二百米處領先，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, wider turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position mid-race, bumped 300m out, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。中段難以保持位置。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。二百米處被?離之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 to 3 lengths behind the leader in the middle of the track, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後領放馬兩至三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。末段衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) On jumping was bumped heavily on the hindquarters and became unbalanced, raced in midfield on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 350M, took the lead 150M, kept on very well to the line, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)躍出時被大力碰撞後軀，因而失去平衡，居中間位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百五十米處時受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，以兩個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 追趕領放馬。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, ridden and challenged leader top of home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and tracked leaders, raced keenly middle stages, close enough turning home but could only keep on at the same speed final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。轉入直路時落後不遠，但最後四百米僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, challenged leader top of home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，追迫領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked pace, improved to challenge 150m out, every chance, just denied.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。已獲機會盡展所長，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W3W) Bustled along after the start to obtain a position ahead of midfield, shifted in abruptly 500M resulting in rider losing balance, failed to pick up pace in the straight. (Warning placed on the horse's racing manners.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W3W) 起步後受催策以佔取中間之前位置。五百米處急促向內斜跑，導致騎師失去平衡。直路上未能加速。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時被帶出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, peaked on run 500M, weakened gradually in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, forced to steady 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。一百米處被迫收慢，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled handy, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Blundered at the Start, sat rear, badly held up in the Straight until 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時失蹄，居後列。直路上嚴重受困直至一百米處。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same margin back on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初向外移出。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W4W) Badly crowded and checked shortly after start, shuffled back, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W4W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫及勒避，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 500M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along to hold position from 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。自六百米處起受推策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, held up and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。受困，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Ridden along early to be 3 back the rail, travelled cozily in the run, moved off the fence 550m out, shifted back in for more racing room final stages and only stayed the same pace thereafter (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 早段受催策，落後三個馬位，走內欄。沿途走勢暢順。五百五十米處移離內欄。末段向內移回以取得更多競賽空間，其後僅保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, switched and followed winner through 300m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線，跟隨頭馬上前。以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Settled well back from the widest draw and waited with, last rounding home bend and one of the widest into straight, ran on well under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，遙居於後，留力候上。轉直路彎時居包尾位置，入直路時走最外疊的馬匹之一。在跑道中央在催策下以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Jumped with them, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened 300M, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策毫無反應。三百米處轉弱。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, responded nicely inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Drawn low and raced on outside towards center of track, in touch, stayed on well for pressure final 200m despite edging left towards leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自最內檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，靠近跑道中央競跑。最後二百米向著領放馬外閃，但在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Out with the rest and sat handy along the Grand Stands' rail 2 lengths behind the leader, held up briefly between 200m and 100m, hit the line strongly once a clear passage was found.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走外欄。二百米處至一百米處之間一度受困。望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。
